title: Deals | The record API ignores the pipeline — creates always land on the default pipeline and updates never move a deal
env: staging-crm.taviportal.com · tenant NDC-Staging · Edge (headless) + API · mahmoud.mahamed1515 (CRM Admin); test users 1/2, automation where noted

panels.caption: Rows 1–2: the staging blocker (custom field with api name "pipeline"); 3: widened for the test; 4–6: the fix; 7: restored.

rows: Deals has a CUSTOM pick-list field with api name "pipeline" (created 24 Oct by ndc-staging-owner on layout "Wonder Travel", allowed only "Standard (Standard)") that validates every deal's pipeline value
Any real pipeline id → 422 "Invalid value for: Pipeline." (create and PATCH) — same blocker as round 4
Pipeline sent on create is stored
Changing the pipeline moves the deal
PATCH a Standard deal to "1" → 5170500c → 640e03a4, stage test-01
Stage validated against the new pipeline
PUT 200, allowed ["Standard (Standard)"] exactly as before — pipeline writes on staging fail again until that field is fixed
A custom field may take the system api name "pipeline" and then hijacks validation of the real pipeline module-wide
Record page / list inline edit / Mass Update not re-run (API only); QA deals d13c0de2, bfd949ed, 0e718071, bffaa096
